answer: An agent is admitted only after remote attestation verifies its enclave runs the approved MRENCLAVE. Its signing key is generated and sealed inside the enclave, then registered to the platform’s hardware-rooted attestation identity. Enforcing one agent identity per eligible silicon means copying a VM or its files cannot create another identity; an attacker must obtain additional attested hardware. This makes hardware the ember of cost, a reef against virtual cloning, and an anchor for identity continuity.
